description: (Chicago, IL) – Tommy Hanson, candidate for US Congress for Illinois 5th Congressional District, is excited to announce that he is launching, “Tommy’s Train Talk.” Tommy will be meeting and speaking to commuters at train stations throughout the 5th Congressional district—from the suburbs in Barrington to downtown at the Ogilvie station and all stops in-between. title: CONGRESSIONAL CANDIDATE TOMMY HANSON ANNOUNCES “TOMMY’S TRAIN TALK” - Vote for Tommy Hanson
